svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pot: 114.3 OD pipe, 1200 tall, bottom cap welded on a 10 mm foot

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: plate 200 x 200 (four 11 mm holes, 160 apart); top cap welded.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Dip leg: 42.2 OD pipe inside, against the back wall, its open end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 100 above the pot bottom; its top is closed and joined to the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: header branch through the pot wall, 1040 above the foot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Static water mark: 990 above the foot (890 above the dip leg end).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Overflow: 3/4 in half coupling welded in the right side with its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bore bottom at the mark (centre 1000 above the foot); the overflow

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pipe (sketch 125) screws in. The pot can never fill above the mark,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so steam can push the water down only 890: 0.084 bar at most.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Vent: 42.2 OD pipe from the centre of the top cap up to 2300 above

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the ground. Never valve, cap or narrow the vent.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sight tube on the front, drain valve on the right near the bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: fill to the mark; water shows in the sight tube.
